name: Keith Haiar
occupation: Crook County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Keith Haiar is a Crook County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Bob Latham, who is serving through the current term. The Sundance Times reported that he led the August 2026 Republican primary with 972 votes and advanced with Fred Devish.
